name: Cheeseburger Egg Smash
notes:
All the flavour of a cheeseburger in one loaded egg mayo smash: cheddar, crispy bacon, tangy cornichons and burger sauce flavours, in a brioche bun.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 9 eggs
• 9 rashers smoked streaky bacon
• 3 tbsp mayonnaise
• 1 tbsp ketchup
• 1½ tbsp 5% fat Greek yoghurt
• 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
• 90g cheddar
• 12 cornichons
• 3 tbsp gherkin brine
• 3 brioche buns

Method:
1. Bring a pan of water to the boil. Lower in the eggs and cook for 8 mins.
2. Meanwhile, heat the grill to high. Lay the bacon on a baking tray and grill for 8–10 mins, until crisp and golden. Leave to cool slightly.
3. Cool the eggs in cold water, then peel. If you like, separate the yolks from the whites.
4. Add the eggs to a large bowl with the mayonnaise, ketchup, Greek yoghurt and Dijon. Grate in the cheddar, snap the cornichons into bite-sized pieces and add them with a splash of the brine. Break the bacon over the top, then smash everything together with a pizza cutter.
5. Grill the brioche buns and put a dollop of the smash in each one. Prepped ahead, the smash keeps in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 2 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 21g, fibre 2g, sugars 13g, sodium 2370mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/cheeseburger-egg-bacon-high-protein-smash
